Role: waiting…Time: 60
Controls: Drag and hold the left joystick to move continuously. Drag the open 3D world to rotate the camera left/right/up/down, like Roblox. Hold the arrow buttons too. Use JUMP for platforms. In Hide & Seek, move and hide if you are a hider, or tag the hiders if you are the seeker. In Zombie Survival, press FIRE to shoot. Keyboard: WASD/arrow keys, Space to jump, F to fire.
Account note: Until Supabase is configured, the game works in guest mode and saves totals on this device. After setup, sign-in enables cloud saves.
